decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - All restorative works and repairs to the building shall match original adjacent work in terms of the choice of materials, method of construction and finished appearance. The minimum of existing material is to be affected during interventions.

Condition : 5 - Detailed drawings of the following items (at a scale of 1:10 internally (1:5 for joinery) and 1:20 externally for new work to the building) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing, prior to the work commencing. 
(i)	internal works
(ii)	new lift enclosure
(iii)	external ramp and paving including handrails and retaining walls
(iv)	restored portico
(v)	garden areas around perimeter of building

The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description:
00570/A/L2 (Listed Building Consent)
Listed building consent for the alterations to Spring Grove House including the provision of a new glass enclosed stair and lift core, a ramp and stair access to north elevation, enclosed gated service yard to north elevation, reinstatement of basement window in east elevation, internal alterations including the removal of redundant external cabling, consolidation of remaining cabling. installation for IT services and accommodation works to Spring Grove House
